priorities.label: Canonical data integrity or workspace-boundary failure
priorities.definition: Loss, corruption, cross-workspace exposure, irreversible identity contamination, or an unrecoverable canonical-state failure. Highest priority.

priorities.label: Accepted user-slice blocker
priorities.definition: A defect or missing contract that prevents an accepted import, profile, identity-review, event, research, or graph user job from working end to end.

priorities.label: Current product foundation and next vertical slice
priorities.definition: The active bootstrap or next accepted vertical slice that establishes canonical ownership and useful end-to-end behavior.

priorities.label: Evidence, identity, or freshness correctness
priorities.definition: Bounded correctness issues in provenance, identity resolution, supersession, current-profile projection, or graph freshness with a usable review/recovery path.

priorities.label: Planned product capability
priorities.definition: An accepted or proposed capability advancing the relationship-intelligence product, ordered after the working foundation.

priorities.label: Integration, collection, and scaling
priorities.definition: Source connectors, scheduling, queueing, performance, provider compatibility, and operational scaling after the core path works.

priorities.label: Observability, maintenance, and documentation
priorities.definition: Operational visibility, test maintenance, dead-code removal, documentation, and housekeeping.

priorities.label: Bounded research or low-evidence observation
priorities.definition: A useful observation or possible edge case that is not demonstrated to block a product outcome; retained without inflating priority.

priorities.label: Deferred by owner
priorities.definition: A real capability or issue deliberately postponed; retained with evidence for later review.

priorities.label: Out of scope or routed elsewhere
priorities.definition: Belongs to Octo, ABA, OIO, or another owner, or is outside this product's accepted scope.
